arguments.query:
WITH PythonProcs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pid, ppid, time, pname, command_line
  FROM audit_logs
  WHERE pname LIKE '%python.exe%'
),
ParentChildNetConns AS (
  SELECT al.time, al.pid, al.ppid, al.pname, al.access, al.remote_ip, al.remote_port, al.command_line
  FROM audit_logs al
  WHERE al.access = 'connect' AND al.remote_ip = '127.0.0.1'
)

SELECT DISTINCT al.time, al.pid, al.ppid, al.pname, al.access, al.remote_ip, al.remote_port, al.command_line
FROM audit_logs al
JOIN PythonProcs pp ON (al.pid = pp.pid OR al.ppid = pp.pid)
JOIN ParentChildNetConns pcn ON al.pid = pcn.pid
ORDER BY al.time DESC
LIMIT 30;
